direction: Modern phone palette, flat colorful app symbols, blue/teal wallpaper, rounded phone widgets. PSX treatment comes from low-resolution bitmaps, limited palettes, dithering and nearest sampling.
mode: Local rasterization of the existing SVG artwork

processing.icons: Rasterize original SVG at 512x384. BOX resize to 128x96 (32x32 cells). For each of the seven app cells, derive a separate four-color median-cut palette from pixels with alpha>=128, quantize with Floyd-Steinberg dithering, and set its brightest palette entry to pure white to preserve white glyphs. Combine the cell palettes, use white for the five original navigation/status glyphs, and threshold alpha at 128. Transparent index 31, optimized 8-bit indexed PNG with at most 32 palette entries.
processing.wallpaper: Rasterize original SVG at 420x735. BOX resize to 120x210; median-cut quantization to 16 colors with Floyd-Steinberg dithering, optimized 4-bit indexed PNG. Preserve source hue and saturation.
processing.sampling: Nearest on both bitmap assets and the composed phone screen.
processing.text: Original Liberation Sans Regular for launcher/system chrome; Liberation Sans Bold for app content.

totals.note: PNG compression reduces disk/download size. GPU textures decode to RGBA. Excludes render target, font atlases and CPU copies.

validation: Dimensions, PNG indexed bit depths and palette limits asserted with Pillow.
All twelve atlas cells populated, binary alpha, seven saturated app colors and white glyphs asserted.
Focused browser captures recorded under art/review/phone-psx.
